title: Honey bee on cape honeysuckle
description: Cape honeysuckle thrives in warm climates and is a popular choice for gardens because of its dazzling flowers and ability to support local wildlife. title: Black eyed Susans
description: Yellow Black-eyed Susans (Rudbeckia hirta) are cheerful wildflowers native to North America, known for their bright yellow petals surrounding a dark brown or black central cone. title: Great egret in the Florida Everglades
